description: Panama's National Institute of Statistics and Census offers online processing of the full census microdata through a REDATAM web system, including the 2023 XII National Population and VIII Housing Census and the four earlier censuses back to 1980. Users can build frequencies, cross tabulations and lists for any geographic area down to populated place, neighbourhood and census segment. The 2023 dwelling dictionary lists dwelling type and condition, tenure and rent, wall, roof and floor materials, rooms, water supply source with the monthly water payment, and unusually the number of days per week and hours per day of water service in the dry and in the rainy season. It also has sanitary service and excreta disposal, lighting type, garbage disposal and cooking fuel. Coverage is national. Format and access: free online processing without registration; no microdata download was found; a dashboard and infographics summarise the results. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the web system suits interactive queries, not bulk harvest; supply hours are as reported by households. Simulation uses: intermittent water supply hours by season and area for water network reliability studies, service access for sanitation, waste and electricity planning, and dwelling materials for exposure. Related records: the Honduras census 2013 housing volume and REDATAM, and the Dominican Republic census 2010 REDATAM.
